data.summary:
Over 11 years of comprehensive experience in the development and implementation of object-oriented enterprise applications using Java/J2EE technologies, with strong expertise in Microservices architecture leveraging Spring Boot, Spring Cloud (Eureka, Gateway, Config Server, Circuit Breaker), RESTful APIs, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, and ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
Strong expertise in Core Java concepts including OOPs, Exception Handling, Generics, Lambda Expressions, and the Stream API.
Proficient in Spring Framework, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring AOP, Spring Batch, Spring Integration (EIP), and SOAP Web Services.
Hands-on experience with Hibernate ORM for database integration and persistence.
Solid experience in microservices architecture, Spring Cloud, and Apache Kafka for scalable and distributed systems.
Skilled in deploying and managing applications on web servers like Apache2, Nginx, and application servers including JBoss 7.x, Tomcat 9.x, and Jetty 9.x.
Proficient in CI/CD practices using Jenkins/GitLab pipeline for automated build and deployment.
Experience with database technologies including Oracle 10g, MySQL, and SQL Server with strong understanding of RDBMS concepts and data modeling.
Familiar with DB client tools such as Squirrel SQL, DBeaver, and Jailer.
Experienced in unit testing with JUnit (BDD style) and code coverage analysis using tools like Jacoco or Inbuilt Intellij.
In-depth understanding of design patterns including Singleton, Immutable, Builder, Factory, etc.
Proficient in version control systems such as Git and SVN.
Hands-on experience in Linux environments (OpenSUSE, RedHat, Debian).
Successfully led the Services Hub migration project in Oslo, Norway, ensuring a seamless transition with significant improvements.
Independently managing the Services Hub (SH) project end-to-end—from requirement analysis to production deployment—since 2017.
Proven experience in cloud migration, with deep expertise in transitioning applications from on-premise environments to the AWS Cloud.
Domain expertise includes Finance, Telecom, E-commerce, Insurance, and Foreign Exchange.
Highly motivated and passionate about taking ownership, embracing new challenges, and contributing effectively throughout the software development lifecycle
Independently migrated more than 3 JBoss EJB-based legacy applications to modern Spring Boot microservices, including CommunicationHub, PricingEngine, DataAnonymization, DocumentService, RateAlert, and RateFeed. Enabled cloud-native capabilities by integrating with Spring Cloud Config Server and AWS Secrets Manager, and containerized deployments using Docker for seamless CI/CD.
Doing L3 support if needed .

Project Name SH(Services Hub) Role Team Member Duration Jan-2016 to Apr-2021 Technology Java1.8, spring core, spring timer-task, spring security, Hibernate, MySQL Server, IntelliJ IDEA, ReactJS ,JQuery, Web Services, maven, SoapUi,RestClient,EC2,RDS Project Description Services Hub is a telecom-based product offering a complete mobile repair management solution. It is currently used by T-Mobile Austria for both in-store (shop users) and end-customer scenarios. The platform integrates with multiple external systems to manage the full mobile repair lifecycle seamlessly. Key integrations include: URLS (Universal Reverse Logistics System): Handles the actual mobile device repair process. Viveum Payment Gateway: Facilitates secure payment transactions for repair services within the Services Hub. Key Features and Functionalities: Case creation for customer-reported mobile defects. Collection of customer and device-related defect information. Box Management: Enables shop users to prepare a single shipment box for multiple devices. Support for DOA (Dead on Arrival) case handling. Upload and management of purchase receipts. Loaner Pool Management: Allows shop users to lend temporary replacement devices to customers. Real-time notifications (email/SMS) sent to customers and shop users for each status update or action performed via URLS, Viveum, or within the Services Hub itself. Roles & Responsibilities: Understood the client's business processes to ensure that technical solutions align with functional requirements. Participated in daily team meetings, discussions, and agile ceremonies to track progress and address blockers. Involved in coding and development of server-side components using Spring, Hibernate, and RESTful web services. Contributed to daily build processes and ensured code stability through continuous integration. Participated in QA, UAT, and Production deployments, ensuring smooth transition across environments. Provided production support, including issue resolution, system monitoring, and root cause analysis.

Project Name SmartyStreets Service Role Lead developer(alone) Duration Jan-2020 to Jan-2021 Technology Java1.8, Spring boot 2.2.0, IntelliJ IDEA, jQuery,Rest Services, Maven Postman Project Description The SmartyStreets Service is a Spring Boot-based microservice designed to perform address validation using the SmartyStreets API. This service acts as a middleware component between the Evavi Application and the external SmartyStreets API. Request Handling: Evavi sends address validation requests to the SmartyStreets Service. External API Integration: The service calls the SmartyStreets API with the provided address data. Response Transformation: Upon receiving the JSON response from SmartyStreets, the service processes and converts it into a predefined XML format. Response Delivery: The XML-formatted address validation response is returned back to the Evavi Application. This architecture ensures encapsulation of third-party API logic within the service and provides a stable, formatted interface to the Evavi Application.
